title: feat(core,plugins): implement P1+P2 roadmap — fuzzy search, history grouping, widget v2, plugin bus, vault API
body:
## Summary / 摘要

实现路线图 P1+P2 中的 14 项功能：模糊搜索、undo/redo 分组、Electron 打包优化、同步滚动、E2E 测试、CI/CD E2E gate、Widget API v2、插件事件总线、高级工具栏（emoji/table）、自定义快捷键 API、版本快照、Web Component、NoteVault 存储抽象、AST 扩展增强。

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: N/A
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): #7, #8, #9, #10, #12, #13, #14, #17, #19, #21, #22, #23, #25, #26
- OpenSpec change: N/A（直接实现，未走 OpenSpec 流程）

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`:
  - `types.ts`: 新增 `ScrollState`、`scrollChange` 事件、`groupChanges()` API、`getKeybindings()`/`setKeybinding()`/`resetKeybinding()`、`WidgetLifecycle`/`priority`/`id`、`NexusPlugin.setup()` 钩子、`remarkPlugins` 支持 `[plugin, options]` 元组格式、`bus` 属性
  - `editor.ts`: 实现 `groupChanges`（dispatch 拦截 + 历史抑制）、`getScrollFraction`/`scrollToFraction`、`scrollChange` 事件 emit、`getKeybindings`/`setKeybinding`、plugin `setup()` 调用、`markdownToHtml` processor 缓存
  - `widget-extension.ts`: 优先级冲突解决、v2 lifecycle hooks（onMount/onUpdate/onUnmount）、`createWidget()` 工厂函数
  - `plugin-bus.ts`: 新增 `PluginBus` 类型安全事件总线
  - `snapshot.ts`: 新增 `SnapshotStorage` 接口 + LCS diff 算法 + 内存实现
  - `vault.ts`: 新增 `NoteVault` 抽象存储接口 + 内存实现
  - `index.ts`: 导出所有新增公共 API

- `packages/plugin-search`:
  - `SearchOptions.fuzzy` 新选项、`SearchMatch.score` 字段、fzf-like 模糊匹配算法（`buildFuzzyPattern` + `computeFuzzyScore`）
  - 9 个新增 fuzzy 搜索测试用例

- `packages/plugin-history`:
  - `HistoryPluginOptions` 配置接口（`newGroupDelay`、`minDepth`）
  - 导出 `isolateHistory` annotation
  - 2 个新增测试用例（groupChanges、newGroupDelay）

- `packages/plugin-toolbar`:
  - `emoji-picker.ts`: 分类 emoji 数据 + 搜索弹出面板
  - `table-tool.ts`: N×M 网格选择器 + Markdown 表格生成
  - 从 index 导出新模块

- `packages/wc` (NEW):
  - `<nexus-editor>` Custom Element，Shadow DOM 隔离
  - 属性：`value`、`live-preview`、`readonly`
  - 事件：`change`、`focus`、`blur` CustomEvent

- `apps/electron-demo`:
  - `package.json`: `compression: "maximum"` + `electron-updater` 依赖
  - `electron/main.ts`: 延迟加载 autoUpdater（3s 后启动，不阻塞首屏）
  - `vite.config.ts`: sourcemap + esbuild minify

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: Playwright 浏览器安装 + E2E 测试 step + 失败时上传 artifact

- `e2e/` (NEW): Playwright 配置 + Electron fixture + 核心交互测试

- `vitest.config.ts`: 排除 `e2e/` 目录

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿（526 tests, 34 files）
- [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过
- [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例：
  - `plugin-search`: 9 个 fuzzy search 测试
  - `plugin-history`: 2 个 groupChanges + newGroupDelay 测试
- [ ] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证：emoji picker、table tool 可通过工具栏触发

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [x] **CLA signed**
- [x] **AI disclosure**: the functional code in this PR is **primarily generated by AI**. AI assistance notes: All 14 features were implemented via AI pair programming — architecture decisions reviewed by human, code generated by AI, tests verified passing.
- [x] **New dependencies** (if any) listed with license & rationale:
  - `@playwright/test@^1.61.1` — Apache-2.0 — E2E testing framework
  - `electron-updater@^6.3.0` — MIT — Auto-update support for packaged Electron app
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [x] Public API changes update package README / types — 类型已同步更新
- [ ] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → walked through the 12 Table Widget rules in CLAUDE.md（本次未改动该文件）
- [ ] New capability / breaking change → OpenSpec proposal linked（多项新能力，建议后续补充 OpenSpec）
- [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4)

## Screenshots / Recordings · 截图或录屏 (UI changes)
